description:
# Phase outcome

Jidoka-owned sequence. Entry: phase 0 public contract. Exit: the CLI uses one public sequence per cell, records validate, and headless work cancels through public handles.

# Ranked child stories

1. `jido_cli-tqg.2.1` — Add a public ordered Jidoka session sequence (P0)
2. `jido_cli-tqg.2.2` — Run automation cells through the public Jidoka sequence (P0)
3. `jido_cli-tqg.2.3` — Validate case results, manifests, and run summaries (P1)
4. `jido_cli-tqg.2.4` — Cancel headless sequences through public Jidoka handles (P1)

# Status rule

All child stories remain open. Story dependency links, not priority alone, control implementation order.
title: Phase 1: Move ordered automation execution into Jidoka
